title: dispatch resumes a stopped worker and keeps its environment and record
goal: backlog.py dispatch --resume SESSION resumes a worker's claude -p session in its worktree with the same KB_OPERATOR, KB_ROLE and capture settings and records the resumed session, so a resumed worker's work rows reach the spool and land finds them

run: import subprocess, sys; r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/backlog.py', 'dispatch', '--help'], capture_output=True, text=True); sys.exit(0 if '--resume' in r.stdout else 1)

notes: SP-czs3jk57 close: ST-lnjebku7's worker was resumed by hand with claude -p --resume; land then warned the item landed with no work rows (no spool file of session 953f2fb7).
